name: Venture Desk
tagline: One weekday brief covering each small online operation you run
description: Each weekday it compiles a short brief on every small online operation you run: traffic, sales, whatever is blocking progress, and the next move worth making. Before a launch it walks a pre-flight checklist with you, so nothing ships half-configured. It reads and reports; decisions stay yours.
author: CorlettScott
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
